scientific_question: Does a refreshable task-selected sparse-Givens chart, driven by the exact current Muon direction and folded into the materialized mlp.c_proj base, close the 124M full-attention-plus-c_proj loss gap without a learned dense basis, dense residual, or LoRA adapter?

causal_optimizer_protocol.matching: At update 0 and every 60 updates, score hidden-channel edges from the exact current coherent Muon polar direction; greedily form 32 unique perfect matchings from 64 neighbors per channel.
causal_optimizer_protocol.angles: At every update, compute the closed-form diagonal tangent-metric angle using only the current scheduled Muon update and the currently selected matchings.
causal_optimizer_protocol.state_transition: Apply the 32 Givens stages to the materialized c_proj weight, apply decoupled weight decay, and fold the result into the persistent base buffer.

serialization_gate.test: A real tiny-GPT forward/backward/custom-optimizer step must round-trip the full model and MultiOptimizer state exactly.
serialization_gate.evidence: 297 passed, 19 skipped, 45 subtests at implementation commit 237189eee1e7f59535b50589e486c840bd48927d

mfu_gate.reason_for_window: The timed window includes the update-60 task-matching refresh, so refresh cost is amortized at the exact registered scientific-run cadence.
mfu_gate.fail: Do not launch scientific training. Optimize the implementation, create a new immutable commit/config/plan identity, and rerun the directly polled gate.
mfu_gate.pass: Authorize exactly one directly polled 238-update smallest-rung scientific run under the immutable config.

decision_rule.primary_metric: terminal fixed-window validation cross entropy at update 238
decision_rule.directional_only: stable terminal CE is below 5.7395 but above 5.5918
decision_rule.reject: terminal CE is at least 5.7395, the run is unstable/incomplete, exact resume fails, or MFU is below 20 percent
decision_rule.success: stable terminal CE is at most 5.5918

execution_policy.do_not_disturb: the existing 985M full-attention run on Y400 GPU0

scope_limit: This is a trainable-coordinate/manifold test. The dense folded c_proj base remains materialized in checkpoints and forward passes, so it does not claim checkpoint-size or inference-FLOP compression.
